mission: Make every canonical DreamCo bot participate in constructive benchmark competition: find measurable gaps, propose non-duplicate fixes, prove improvements, and share winning improvements across the fleet.
applies_to: every canonical bot and declared capability
competition_is_for: reducing time to goal and unnecessary human steps
improving correctness, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, cost and performance
reaching or exceeding verified competitor and open-source parity

participation.specialist_priority: Bots closest to a gap domain compete first; unrelated bots may contribute reusable approaches, tests, research, or review without taking canonical ownership.
participation.buddy_role: Buddy is the user-facing orchestrator that explains gaps, routes work, surfaces progress, and applies verified fleet improvements through canonical owners.
participation.builder_role: Builder bots turn winning measured proposals into reviewable changes and retest them through the parallel benchmark-gap system.

gap_challenge_cycle: measure and publish a machine-readable gap with baseline, target and evidence
identify the canonical capability owner and relevant specialist bots
invite eligible bots to submit bounded improvement proposals
deduplicate proposals by root cause and affected canonical owner
score proposals before implementation on expected impact, risk, effort, reuse and guardrail fit
select one or more non-conflicting proposals for parallel builder lanes
implement on reviewable changes without overlapping canonical ownership
run identical benchmark fixtures plus regression and guardrail tests
promote reusable winning improvements into shared infrastructure when appropriate
retest affected bots and competitors/open-source baselines
close the gap only when the target and definition of done pass

verified_scorecard.rule: No points or wins without reproducible evidence.

dimensions.measure: percentage of target gap actually closed
same-fixture correctness and domain quality improvement
repeatability, failure handling, rollback and recovery
latency, throughput, CPU, memory, storage, network, tokens and cost
time to goal, user steps and safe autonomy
security, privacy, permissions, rights and guardrail preservation
number of other canonical bots/capabilities that benefit without duplication
testability, documentation, dependency health and canonical ownership clarity

disqualifiers: fabricated or stale evidence represented as current
benchmark-specific hack that harms general capability

team_modes.description: Two or more relevant bots propose different ways to close the same measured gap.
Bots from different divisions solve independent portions of a shared benchmark gap in parallel.
One team proposes a fix while another attacks assumptions, edge cases, security, privacy and regressions.
Relevant bots compare Buddy against approved open-source capability and compete to reach verified parity through lawful integration or original implementation.
Relevant bots compete to close measured differences against selected top-30 competitor/substitute baselines.
Reward fixes that improve many bots through shared canonical infrastructure instead of per-bot patches.

truth_rule: Competition status is an engineering coordination signal, not proof that all bots are currently running autonomously. A bot participates only when its benchmark fixtures, routing, dependencies and execution environment are available.
